verdict.rationale: Alma's portal shows some data-driven guidance. The homepage claims a system that 'flags risk early' and gives visibility on every case, case work draws on 'case intelligence pulled from hundreds of prior filings', and visa options are shown with suggestion tiers (Recommended / Strong / Backup). None of this is described as AI-generated, and there is no evidence of an in-product AI assistant producing insights from the user's own data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the insights or suggestions are AI-generated, documentation of an in-product AI insight feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
